name: Does adding a watermark upload my PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Watermarking is done entirely in your browser using pdf-lib. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Can I add an image as a watermark instead of text?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree supports both text watermarks and image watermarks (PNG/JPG).

name: Can I control watermark opacity and position?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can adjust opacity, size, position, and rotation angle.
